QuestInfo.name: [Glory] Basic Mission: Investigate the Ancient Gods' Power
QuestInfo.0:
#bBasic Mission: Investigate the Ancient Gods' Power#k

#eMission Period#n
01/15/2020 12:00 AM - 01/28/2020 11:59 PM UTC

#eEvent Details#n
The Maple Alliance suspects that recent anomalies occurring in Maple World are tied to the power of the ancient gods. Neinheart has tasked you with investigating.

Hunt #e#rmonsters near your level#n#k with the #rGlory Guard Medal#k in your possession to gather the #rpower of the ancient gods#k.


#bYou cannot participate in this mission if you've already reached the daily Glory limit.#k
